map.📖 查看「质量（标准/评估/改进）体系 使用指南」: View the Quality (Standard/Assessment/Improvement) System User Guide
map.养老服务质量得分 = 服务响应 + 专业能力 + 服务规范 + 满意度 + 安全: Eldercare service quality score = service response + professional competence + service standardisation + satisfaction + safety management (1 to 5 points each); average = total / 5; an average of 4.5 or above is excellent, 3.5 to 4.4 is good, 2.5 to 3.4 is average, below 2.5 is fail; the improvement plan is made for the lowest scoring dimension.
map.养老服务质量评估体系（5维度，每项1-5分，总分5-25）: Eldercare service quality assessment system (5 dimensions, 1-5 points each, 5-25 total)
map.养老服务机构质量自评中，按服务响应、专业能力、服务规范、满意度、安全管理五维打分: In the quality self-assessment of an eldercare institution, scores are given on five dimensions: service response, professional competence, service standardisation, satisfaction and safety management.
map.均值用于判定优秀/良好/一般/不合格，并定位需改进维度。: The mean is used to determine excellent/good/average/fail and to locate the dimensions needing improvement.
map.质量改进闭环：达标维度保持，≤2 分维度列入整改。: Quality improvement loop: keep the dimensions that pass, and put any dimension scoring <=2 into rectification.
map.算例：五维均评 5 分: Worked example: all five dimensions scored 5
map.质量总分 = 25 / 25，均值 = 5.00 → 『质量优秀』，建议总结经验: Total quality score = 25 / 25, mean = 5.00 -> 'quality excellent'; recommended to summarise and promote the experience and keep the standard.
map.算例：五维均评 3 分: Worked example: all five dimensions scored 3
map.总分 = 15，均值 = 3.00 → 『质量一般』，需制定改进计划、加强培训与: Total = 15, mean = 3.00 -> 'quality average'; an improvement plan is needed, with stronger training and process optimisation (the 2.5-3.5 mean band).
map.质量等级怎么划分？: How are the quality levels classified?
map.按五维均值：≥4.5 优秀、≥3.5 良好、≥2.5 一般、<2.5 不合格（满: By the mean of the five dimensions: >=4.5 excellent, >=3.5 good, >=2.5 average, <2.5 fail (25 in total, 0-5 per dimension). A fail requires immediate rectification and a re-check within a set deadline.
map.哪一维低分最该优先改？: Which low-scoring dimension should be fixed first?
map.安全管理和服务规范通常与事故风险直接相关，单维≤2 即触发整改；建议先补齐安全制: Safety management and service standardisation are usually directly related to accident risk, and a single dimension scoring <=2 triggers rectification; recommended to complete the safety rules and standard processes first, then improve competence and satisfaction.
